install_as: system_ext privileged system app, own UID, own signing certificate
hidden_api_condition: Preinstalled (or updated system) app and usesNonSdkApi=true. Donor ApplicationInfo permits this without the platform signer or a whitelist. A user-installed APK does not meet this condition.
policy_merge_status: Component template only. No parent policy files modified and no merged policy compiled. Parent must run strict linkage/neverallow checks; do not use -N to conceal violations.
headless_users: Headless system user 0 is refused; normal full user 0 and full user 10 require both Bluetooth grants and an unlocked user. Unlock is needed for the private per-user credential-encrypted journal. Missing Bluetooth grants stop the service safely, without touching lazy resources or auto-granting.
refresh_rate: Automatic per-user peak_refresh_rate cap to 120.0 only with Settings.System.canWrite. Reuses native pencilStatus and vendor/MAC fallback. Never raises a finite owner cap <=120. Private committed journal restores exact previous value or unset only while the public value is still our cap. Observed owner changes win and suppress recapping for that active session. Failed/denied restore retains the desired value for a later permitted retry. Active ACK still uses actual display refresh, not Settings.
permission_revocation: Recheck before queued work and each Bluetooth Binder boundary. Catch SecurityException only when rechecking confirms access was lost; unexpected security failures with intact permissions propagate. Cleanup attempts are idempotent; no secret-bearing exception/address/payload logs.
foreground_service: connectedDevice; foreground promotion before listener setup; low-importance ongoing notification 1001 distinct from pairing notification 1000; no wake lock or freezer exemption
startup_attachment: Read present and ble_mac_addr once after registering the uevent observer. Validate the driver address and reconcile an already attached pen; denied reads leave event-driven pairing available.
